// diagnostic E1806

Jet.ServiceImportOutsideCore

`{name}` imports a `{provider}` service, which only Core declares

What

`{name}` imports a `{provider}` service, which only Core declares

Why

The compiler and build host answer each `{provider}` symbol for the declaration Core writes for it; the provider, not a program, decides which services exist and where they run.

Fix

Call the Core function or method that declares this service, such as `core.build` or `core.compiler`.

Worked example
